actions.text: The rift lets go of you, and there is no floor but the one you stand on. Islands of old stone hang in a sky the colour of a bruise.
The Reach. I have read about it, in a book that was supposed to be fiction. It is where the first door was forced, and the world has never healed.
Then someone is still holding the doors open. Let's find them.
The Harbinger kneels. Its robe unravels into threads of dusk, and where it stood a seam of pale light hangs open in the air.
...You think... I was the hand? I was only... the door's keeper. The one who holds the doors... the Whole... is still... out there. It remembers... you.
Three doors, and a keeper that answers to someone. That is why the signal on the console would not resolve. There is a fourth coordinate, and it was never ours to read.
'It remembers you.' I do not remember it. But when it said that, something in me answered.
A shard of something knows another when it meets one. I have a theory I do not like yet. Let me finish it before I say it out loud.
Then we follow the signal. Whoever they are, they took people from their homes. That ends.
The reflection shatters into drifting glass, and one pane lands upright, humming.
You find
The penitent folds into a pile of cloth. A pouch of shards is tied to its belt.
You find

objectives.text: Fight across the floating ruins and defeat the Breach Warden to open the gate to the second court.
Cross the bridge and defeat the Rift Harbinger in its arena.
The Harbinger has fallen. Step through the rift gate back to Outpost Kestrel.

encounters.text: The Reach stirs... something steps out of the broken sky!

actions.text: THE SECOND COURT IS SEALED. THE HARBINGER WILL NOT BE DISTURBED.
Something tall stands at the heart of the arena, robed in the same dark as the sky. It does not turn. It has been waiting.
Three doors I opened. A fisherman's island. A sea of sand and cheering. A rock in the dark. Each one drew a fighter through.
And now the best of them has walked to the hand that held the doors. How generous.
You took people from their homes. You made them fight. Give them back.
Give them back? They were never lost. They were gathered.
You are the one door that was never ours to open. The Whole has been searching for you since the sky first broke. Come, then. Be gathered.
RIFT HARBINGER
A figure steps out of a seam in the air wearing your own stance. Its face is a smear of light.
A cloaked figure kneels at the edge, facing the void. 'Do you hear it? It is not angry. It is only hungry.'
THE REACH. WHEN THE ONE WAS SHATTERED, THE FIRST PIECE FELL HERE. WHAT YOU WALK ON IS WHAT WAS LEFT OVER.

The stone hums against your palm. Across the Reach, the wardens reset and the gate slides shut.

actions.text: THE FIRST COURT. THE WARDEN WAS A FORGE ONCE; THE BREACH GAVE IT A PURPOSE AND TOOK EVERYTHING ELSE.
BEYOND THIS BRIDGE: THE HARBINGER. IT HAS NOT BEEN IDLE. EVERY FIGHTER THE RAIDERS TOOK PASSED UNDER ITS HAND FIRST.
